name: openfea
description: Local-first browser CAD and finite element analysis for static, dynamic, modal, and thermal studies.

scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @openfea/api build && pnpm --filter @openfea/web build
scripts.build:core: pnpm --filter @openfea/core build && pnpm --filter @openfea/examples build && pnpm --filter @openfea/solver-cpu build && pnpm --filter @openfea/solver-webgpu build && pnpm --filter @openfea/viewer build
scripts.verify:perf: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @openfea/web build && node scripts/verify-web-performance.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm verify:cloudflare-config && pnpm build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:dry-run: pnpm verify:cloudflare-config && pnpm build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:retired-do-cleanup: pnpm verify:cloudflare-config && pnpm build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.retired-do-cleanup.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" --if-present typecheck && pnpm --filter @openfea/api exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @openfea/web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.reset:local: pnpm --filter @openfea/db reset && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
